data.titulo: Tasal 3—Chalen Relikebʼ Egipto Toj Naq Keʼxkʼe li Xbʼeen Awabʼej re Israel
data.contenido:
Laj Moises kirisihebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Egipto ut kixkʼamebʼ saʼ li tzuul Sinai, aran li Yos kixkʼe li xchaqʼrabʼ re li xtenamit. Chirix chik aʼan laj Moises kixtaqla 12 chi winq chi rilbʼal li tenamit Canaan. Abʼan 10 rehebʼ li winq keʼxye naq li wankebʼ Canaan jwal nimebʼ ut kawebʼ ribʼ, joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼraj sutqʼiik Egipto. Li Yos kichalk xjosqʼil xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj Israel moko kawebʼ ta xpaabʼal. Ut kixkʼehebʼ chi xbʼeeninkil ribʼ saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ chiru 40 chihabʼ.

Tojaʼ naq li Yos kixsikʼ ru laj Josue re naq aʼan tkʼamoq rehebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Canaan. Li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu ebʼ li sachbʼachʼoolej re naq teʼruuq reechaninkil li tenamit. Kixbʼaanu naq li nimaʼ Jordan tchaqik, kixbʼaanu naq li xnubʼaal li tenamit Jerico ttʼaneʼq ut kixbʼaanu ajwiʼ naq li Saqʼe tkanaaq saʼ xyi li choxa chiru jun kutan. Naq kinumeʼk waqibʼ chihabʼ ebʼ laj Israel keʼreechani li tenamit Canaan.

Chiru 356 chihabʼ junes ebʼ aj raqol aatin keʼawabʼejink re li tenamit Israel. Laj Josue kiwank choʼq xbʼeen aj raqol aatin. Qatzolaq chirix laj Barac, laj Gedeon, laj Jefte, laj Sanson ut laj Samuel. Joʼkan ajwiʼ chirixebʼ li ixq joʼ li xRahab, li xDebora, li xJael, li xRut, li xNoemi ut xDalila. Chiru 396 chihabʼ kikʼulmank chixjunil li wank saʼ li ROX Tasal aʼin.

MA NAKAANAW kʼaru yookebʼ xxokbʼal ebʼ li qas qiitzʼin? Aʼan tzakahemq. Li tzakahemq aʼin chanchan poqs ut saq ru.

Anaqwan ebʼ laj Israel wankebʼ saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ, ak xnumeʼk tana jun po naq keʼelk chaq Egipto. Saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ raasa naʼelk li awimq. Joʼkan naq keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Us wanko chaq Egipto xbʼaan naq aran wank naabʼal li qatzakahemq›.

Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye: ‹Tintaqla saʼ xbʼeenebʼ li tzakahemq›. Naq kisaqewk ebʼ laj Israel keʼxye: ‹Kʼaru wank chiru li chʼochʼ?›

Laj Moises kixye: ‹Aʼin li tzakahemq kixtaqla chaq li Jehobʼa choʼq eere›. MANA keʼxkʼe choʼq xkʼabʼaʼ li tzakahemq. Li xsahil li mana chanchan li wa rikʼin xyaʼal kabʼ.

Laj Moises kixye rehebʼ laj Israel: ‹Kaʼajwiʼ teexok joʼnimal tixtzaka li junjunq›. Ut aʼan keʼxbʼaanu wulaj wulaj. Li mana li kikanaak chiru chʼochʼ kijahoʼk xbʼaan li Saqʼe.

Laj Moises kixye ajwiʼ rehebʼ: ‹Maaʼani tixkʼuula li mana choʼq re xwulaj›. Abʼan, ma nakaanaw kʼaru keʼxkʼul li inkʼaʼ keʼabʼink chiru? Naq kisaqewk, li mana li keʼxkʼuula kimotzoʼink ut kichuhoʼk ru. Abʼan li Jehobʼa kixye rehebʼ naq kaʼajwiʼ saʼ li xwaq kutan teʼxxok kaʼsut xkʼihal li mana. Xbʼaan naq saʼ xwuq li kutan li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ kixtaqlahebʼ xtzakahemq. Naq keʼxxok li mana choʼq re li jun chik kutan inkʼaʼ kimotzoʼink, chi moko kichuhoʼk ta. Aʼin jun chik li sachbʼachʼoolej kixkʼut li Jehobʼa chiruhebʼ.

Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxtzaka li mana chiru chixjunil li chihabʼ naq keʼwank saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ.Éxodo 16:1-36; Números 11:7-9; Josué 5:10-12. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

AK WIIBʼ po relikebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Egipto naq keʼwulak saʼ li tzuul Sinai malaj Horeb. Saʼ li tzuul aʼin li Jehobʼa kiraatina chaq laj Moises. Arin keʼkanaak ebʼ laj Israel chiru naabʼal kutan.

Naq laj Moises kitaqeʼk saʼ li tzuul, ebʼ laj Israel keʼkanaak taqʼa chi roybʼeeninkil. Ut li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises naq traj naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼabʼinq chiru ut teʼwanq choʼq xtenamit. Naq laj Moises kikubʼeek, kixchʼolobʼ chiruhebʼ laj Israel li kixye chaq li Jehobʼa. Chixjunilebʼ keʼxye naq teʼabʼinq chiru li Jehobʼa xbʼaan naq nekeʼraj wank choʼq xtenamit.

Anaqwan, ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu li Jehobʼa? Kirisi chaq li sibʼ saʼ xbʼeen li tzuul ut kireekʼasi chaq li kaaq. Chirix chik aʼan kiʼaatinak rikʼin li tenamit ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Laaʼin li Jehobʼa li kiʼisink chaq aawe Egipto›. Tojaʼ naq kixkʼe li chaqʼrabʼ aʼin rehebʼ: ‹Maaloqʼoni jalanebʼ chik yos chiwu laaʼin›.

Li Yos kixkʼe bʼeleebʼ chik li chaqʼrabʼ rehebʼ laj Israel. Li tenamit yook xxiw, joʼkan naq keʼxye re laj Moises: ‹Aatinan laaʼat qikʼin, xbʼaan naq naru tookamq wi li Yos t-aatinaq qikʼin›.

Chirix chik aʼan li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises: ‹Taaqenk chaq saʼ li tzuul. Tinkʼe aawe li wiibʼ chi perpookil pek, bʼarwiʼ xintzʼiibʼa linchaqʼrabʼ re naq teʼxyuʼami li tenamit›. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kitaqeʼk wiʼ chik saʼ li tzuul ut kiwank chaq aran 40 kutan ut qʼoqyink.

Naabʼal li chaqʼrabʼ kixkʼe li Yos re li xtenamit ut laj Moises kitzʼiibʼank re chixjunil aʼ in. Li wiibʼ chi perpookil pek li kixkʼe li Yos re laj Moises. Aʼan li lajeebʼ chi chaqʼrabʼ kixtzʼiibʼa li Yos.

Li lajeebʼ chi chaqʼrabʼ wank xwankil. Joʼkan ajwiʼ chixjunil li xchaqrabʼ li Yos. Jun rehebʼ li chaqʼrabʼ naxye: ‹Taara li Jehobʼa chi anchal laachʼool, chi anchal laakʼaʼuxl, chi anchal laawanm ut chi anchal laametzʼew›. Jun chik li chaqʼrabʼ naxye: ‹Chaara laawas aawiitzʼin joʼ naq nakaara aawibʼ laaʼat›. Li Jesus kixye naq aʼin li wiibʼ xnimal ru li chaqʼrabʼ kixkʼe li Yos re li xtenamit. Moqon chik tootzoloq chirix li Jesus ut chanru kikʼutuk chaq.Éxodo 19:1-25; 20:1-21; 24:12-18; 31:18; Deuteronomio 6:4-6; Levítico 19:18; Mateo 22:36-40. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

KʼARU yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil ebʼ laj Israel? Yookebʼ chi tijok chiru jun li pechʼbʼil yos. Kʼajoʼ xyiibʼal ru li yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil! Kʼaʼut naq yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil aʼin?

Naq laj Moises kibʼayk chaq saʼ li tzuul, ebʼ laj Israel keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Inkʼaʼ naqanaw kʼaru xkʼul chaq laj Moises. Joʼkan naq qayiibʼaq junaq qayos re naq toorisi saʼ li naʼaj aʼin›.

Laj Aaron, ras laj Moises, kixsume xbʼaanunkil li pechʼbʼil yos ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Kʼamomaq chaq we leekaʼxik ut leematqʼabʼ re oor›. Naq li tenamit kixbʼaanu aʼin, laj Aaron kiroksi li oor re xyiibʼankil jun li pechʼbʼil yos. Tojaʼ naq keʼxye: ‹Aʼin li qayos li kiʼisink chaq qe Egipto›. Chirix chik aʼan keʼxbʼaanu jun li ninqʼe ut keʼxloqʼoni li pechʼbʼil yos.

Li Jehobʼa kichalk xjosqʼil naq kiril aʼin. Ut kixye re laj Moises: ‹Ayu ut seebʼa aawibʼ, ilebʼ chaq laj Israel yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil li inkʼaʼ us. Xeʼxtzʼeqtaana linchaqʼrabʼ ut keʼxwiqʼibʼ ribʼ chiru jun li pechʼbʼil yos re oor›. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kikubʼeek chaq saʼ junpaat. Ut naq kiril naq yookebʼ chi xajok ut chi bʼichank chiru li pechʼbʼil yos, kʼajoʼ naq kichalk xjosqʼil! Joʼkan naq kixkut chiru chʼochʼ li xchaqʼrabʼ li Yos ut keʼjoreʼk. Chirix chik aʼan, kixpukʼi li pechʼbʼil yos.

Nimla maak kixbʼaanu li tenamit. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kixye re jun chʼuut chi winq: ‹Chapomaq leechʼiichʼ ut teekamsi li keʼloqʼonink re li pechʼbʼil yos›. Joʼkan naq 3.000 keʼkamk. Aʼin naxkʼut chiqu naq kaʼajwiʼ li Jehobʼa tento tqaloqʼoni ru.Éxodo 32:1-35. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW kʼaru wank saʼ li eetalil? Aʼan Rochoch li Jehobʼa, bʼarwiʼ keʼxloqʼoni ru. Naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼelk chaq Egipto keʼok xyiibʼankil li ochoch aʼin ut keʼxbʼaanu chiru jun chihabʼ. Ma nakaanaw ani kiraj naq teʼxyiibʼ li ochoch?

Li Jehobʼa kitaqlank re xyiibʼankil li ochoch aʼin. Naq laj Moises wank chaq saʼ li tzuul Sinai, li Jehobʼa kixye re chanru teʼxyiibʼ li ochoch re naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼruuq xkʼambʼal chirixebʼ. Naq ebʼ laj Israel nekeʼxjal xnaʼaj moko chʼaʼaj ta chiruhebʼ naq nekeʼxyiibʼ wiʼ chik li Rochoch li Yos.

Saʼ li ochoch aʼin, wank xnaʼaj jun li kaax. Aʼan xkaaxil li sumwank. Saʼ xbʼeen li kaax wank wiibʼ li anjel yiibʼanbʼilebʼ rikʼin oor. Chisaʼ li kaax aʼin, wank li lajeebʼ chi chaqʼrabʼ li kixtzʼiibʼa wiʼ chik li Yos, xbʼaan naq laj Moises kixjor li wiibʼ chi perpookil pek li kikʼeheʼk re xbʼeenwa. Chisaʼ li kaax kixokmank ajwiʼ jun xaar li mana. Ma jultik aawe kʼaru li mana?

Li Jehobʼa kixsikʼ ru laj Aaron, li ras laj Moises, re naq twanq choʼq xyuwaʼil aj tij. Aʼan kikʼamok bʼe chiruhebʼ laj Israel re xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa. Ebʼ li ralal laj Aaron yookebʼ ajwiʼ chi kʼanjelak choʼq aj tij.

Saʼ li Rochoch li Yos wank jun li nimla naʼaj. Ma nakaawil naq aran ajwiʼ wank jun li kaax? Saʼ li kaax aʼin ebʼ laj tij nekeʼxkʼat li sununkil pom. Wank jun xnaʼaj kandeel wuqubʼ xxamlel. Joʼkan ajwiʼ wank jun li meex ut saʼ xbʼeen wank 12 chi kaxlan wa. Saʼ xmuhebʼaal li Rochoch li Yos wank jun nimla naʼaj haʼ. Aran nekeʼxchʼaj ribʼ laj tij. Wank ajwiʼ jun nimla naʼaj re xmayejankil li xul. Ebʼ laj tij nekeʼmayejak chiru li Jehobʼa. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxyiibʼ rochochebʼ chire li naʼaj aʼin. Joʼkan naq li Rochoch li Yos kikanaak saʼ xyihebʼ.Éxodo 25:8-40; 26:1-37; 27:1-8; 28:1; 30:1-10, 17-21; 34:1, 2; Hebreos 9:1-5. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

CHAAWIL ruhebʼ li awimq. Kʼajoʼ xnimal xchiijilal li uubʼ! Joʼkan naq ebʼ li winq yookebʼ xpaqonkil li uubʼ rikʼin jun li cheʼ. Chaawil ajwiʼ ebʼ li iig ut ebʼ li kranadiiy. Bʼar keʼxkʼam chaq ru li awimq aʼin? Kʼexkʼam chaq saʼ li tenamit Canaan. Ma jultik aawe naq Canaan keʼwank chaq laj Abrahan, laj Isaac ut laj Jacob. Abʼan naq kiwank li weʼej, laj Jacob ut li xjunkabʼal kohebʼ Egipto. Ebʼ laj Israel toj wankebʼ saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ saʼ li naʼajej Qades. Kinumeʼk 216 chihabʼ naq laj Moises ut ebʼ laj Israel keʼsutqʼiik saʼ li tenamit Canaan.

Ebʼ li wankebʼ Canaan maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kixtaqla 12 chi winq ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Cheerilaq chaq jarubʼebʼ wankebʼ Canaan ut ma kawebʼ ribʼ. Teeril ma us li chʼochʼ re awk ut teekʼam chaq junjunq ru li awinq›.

Naq keʼsutqʼiik chaq ebʼ li winq, keʼxye re laj Moises: ‹Chaabʼil li chʼochʼ wank Canaan›. Joʼkan naq keʼxkʼam chaq ru li awimq re naq teʼpaabʼaaq rehebʼ. Abʼan 10 rehebʼ li winq aʼin keʼxye: ‹Li wankebʼ Canaan jwal nimebʼ ut kawebʼ ribʼ. Wi tqamaqʼ li tenamit chiruhebʼ, tooʼexkamsi›.

Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxxuwak naq keʼrabʼi aʼin ut keʼxye: ‹Us raj xookam Egipto malaj saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ aʼin! Anaqwan tookamq saʼ li yalok. Ebʼ li qixaqil ut ebʼ li qakokʼal teʼkʼameʼq choʼq moos Canaan. Joʼkan naq qasikʼaq reqaj laj Moises ut sutqʼiiqo Egipto!›

Abʼan wiibʼ rehebʼ li winq aʼin, laj Josue ut laj Caleb, kʼojkʼookebʼ xchʼool rikʼin li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq keʼxyal xwaklesinkil xchʼool li tenamit ut keʼxye: ‹Mexxuwak, li Jehobʼa wank qikʼin. Moko chʼaʼaj ta reechaninkil li tenamit!› Abʼan li tenamit inkʼaʼ kiraj rabʼinkil aʼin ut keʼraj xkamsinkil laj Josue ut laj Caleb.

Joʼkan naq kichalk xjosqʼil li Jehobʼa ut kixye re laj Moises: ‹Maajun rehebʼ li wank junmay chihabʼ re malaj naxqʼax junmay t-ok saʼ li tenamit Canaan. Usta keʼril li sachbʼachʼoolej kinbʼaanu Egipto ut saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ, toj maajiʼ nekeʼxkʼojobʼ xchʼool chiwu. Joʼkan naq teʼxbʼeeni ribʼ saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ chiru 40 chihabʼ toj reetal teʼkamq. Kaʼajwiʼ laj Josue ut laj Caleb teʼoq Canaan›.Números 13:1-33; 14:1-38. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

SAʼ LI eetalil wank jun li xuqʼ kiʼatzʼumak ru. Aʼan li xxuqʼ laj Aaron. Chiru jun qʼoqyink ajwiʼ kiʼatzʼumak ru! Qilaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.

Naabʼal chihabʼ keʼwank laj Israel saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ. Abʼan laj Core, laj Datan, laj Abiram ut 250 ebʼ aj jolominel inkʼaʼ keʼraj naq laj Moises tjolominq rehebʼ, chi moko keʼraj ta naq laj Aaron twanq choʼq aj tij. Joʼkan naq keʼxye re laj Moises: ‹Kʼaʼut nakaakʼe aawankil saʼ qabʼeen?›

Laj Moises kixye rehebʼ: ‹Chalqex wulaj eqʼla saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa ut teekʼam chaq xnaʼaj leepom ut teekʼe li pom chisaʼ. Ut tqil ani laj jolominel tixsikʼ ru li Jehobʼa›.

Naq kisaqewk laj Core ut ebʼ li 250 chi winq keʼwulak saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa ut naabʼalebʼ chik keʼokenk chirixebʼ. Kʼajoʼ naq kichalk xjosqʼil li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kixye re li tenamit: ‹Elenqex chiru li rochoch laj Core, laj Datan ut laj Abiram ut maakʼaʼ kʼaru rehebʼ teechʼeʼ›. Li tenamit kiʼabʼink chiru laj Moises.

Chirix chik aʼan kixye laj Moises: ‹Rikʼin aʼin teenaw ani tixsikʼ ru li Jehobʼa. Tixte ribʼ li chʼochʼ ut aran teʼkamq li winq aʼin›.

Naq laj Moises kiraqeʼk chi aatinak kixte ribʼ li chʼochʼ. Laj Datan, laj Abiram, ebʼ li xjunkabʼal ut chixjunil li wank saʼebʼ li rochoch kiʼok saʼ li jul. Naq kikʼulmank aʼin laj Core inkʼaʼ kikamk kaʼajwiʼ li xjunkabʼal ut ebʼ li kʼa ru re xkohebʼ saʼ li jul. Chirix chik aʼan, kixtzʼap ribʼ li chʼochʼ. Naq keʼxjap rehebʼ li keʼtʼaneʼk saʼ li jul, ebʼ li keʼabʼink rehebʼ keʼxye: ‹Elenqo arin, xbʼaan naq naru ajwiʼ tookamq saʼ li jul!›

Laj Core ut li 250 chi winq toj wankebʼ chiru li Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixtaqla chaq xaml saʼ xbʼeenebʼ ut chixjunilebʼ keʼkamk. Chirix chik aʼan li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Eleazar, ralal laj Aaron, naq tixxok xnaʼajebʼ li xpom ebʼ li keʼkamk ut rikʼin aʼan tixyiibʼ li perpookil chʼiichʼ re xtzʼapbʼal xbʼeen li naʼaj bʼarwiʼ nekeʼxkʼat li pom. Li perpookil chʼiichʼ aʼan reetalil naq kaʼajwiʼ laj Aaron ut ebʼ li ralal teʼkʼanjelaq choʼq aj tij chiru li Jehobʼa.

Li Jehobʼa naraj naq li tenamit tixnaw naq kaʼajwiʼ laj Aaron ut ebʼ ralal keʼsikʼeʼk ru choʼq aj tij. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Moises: ‹Li nekeʼjolomink re li junjunq chi teep teʼxkʼam chaq xxuqʼebʼ. Laj Aaron tixkʼam chaq ajwiʼ li xxuqʼ choʼq xteepal laj Levi. Ut taakʼe ebʼ li xuqʼ chiru xkaaxil li sumwank. Li xxuqʼ li winq li tinsikʼ ru choʼq aj tij aʼan t-atzʼumak ru›.

Naq kisaqewk laj Moises kiril naq li xxuqʼ laj Aaron kiʼatzʼumak ru. Ma nakaanaw anaqwan kʼaʼut naq li Jehobʼa kixkʼe chi atzʼumak li xxuqʼ laj Aaron?Números 16:1-49; 17:1-11; 26:10. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Laj Moises Kixtochʼ Jun li Pek
data.contenido:
KINUMEʼK 10 chihabʼ, 20 chihabʼ, 30 chihabʼ ut 39 chihabʼ ut ebʼ laj Israel toj wankebʼ saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ. Chiruhebʼ li chihabʼ aʼin, li Jehobʼa kixkʼaakʼale li xtenamit ut kixkʼe choʼq xtzakahemq li mana. Chiru li kutan kixbʼeeresihebʼ rikʼin choql ut chiru li qʼoqyink rikʼin xaml. Inkʼaʼ kiʼosoʼk li raqʼebʼ chi moko kirahoʼk ta li roqebʼ.

Anaqwan yookebʼ xtikibʼankil 40 chihabʼ relikebʼ Egipto. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼsutqʼiik saʼ li naʼaj Qades. Arin wankebʼ naq laj Moises kixtaqla 12 chi winq chi rilbʼal li tenamit Canaan. Li xMiriam, ranabʼ laj Moises, kikamk saʼ li naʼaj Qades. Saʼ li naʼaj aʼin wank chʼaʼajkilal joʼ kiwank chaq najter.

Ebʼ laj Israel maakʼaʼebʼ xhaʼ. Joʼkan naq keʼok xyeebʼal re laj Moises: ‹Us raj xookamk. Kʼaʼut naq xooʼaawisi Egipto ut xooʼaakʼam chaq saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ? Inkʼaʼ nayoʼlaak ru li awimq saʼ li chʼochʼ aʼin. Chi moko wank ta haʼ›.

Naq laj Moises ut laj Aaron kohebʼ saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa chi tijok, li Yos kixye re laj Moises: ‹Chʼutubʼ li tenamit ut taawaatina li pek chiruhebʼ. Saʼ li pek aʼan t-elq chaq naabʼal li haʼ choʼq rehebʼ laj Israel ut ebʼ li xketomq›.

Joʼkan naq laj Moises kixchʼutubʼ li tenamit ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Abʼihomaq, laaʼex li nekexweechʼink re li Yos. Laj Aaron ut laaʼin tqisi eehaʼ saʼ li pek aʼin›. Joʼkan naq laj Moises wiibʼ sut kixtochʼ li pek rikʼin li xxuqʼ. Tojaʼ naq nabʼulbʼutq chaq chi elk li haʼ. Anaqwan wank chik xhaʼ li tenamit ut ebʼ li ketomq.

Abʼan li Jehobʼa kichalk xjosqʼil rikʼin laj Moises ut laj Aaron. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut? Xbʼaan naq laj Moises ut laj Aaron keʼxye re li tenamit naq aʼanebʼ teʼisinq chaq re li haʼ ut inkʼaʼ keʼxye naq li Jehobʼa tbʼaanunq re. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye rehebʼ: ‹Moko laaʼex ta texʼoksinq re lintenamit saʼ li naʼaj Canaan›.

Chirix chik aʼan ebʼ laj Israel keʼelk chaq Qades. Ut keʼwulak saʼ li tzuul Hor. Saʼ li tzuul aʼin kikamk laj Aaron naq wank 123 chihabʼ re. Kʼajoʼ naq keʼrahoʼk saʼ xchʼool ebʼ laj Israel naq kikamk laj Aaron! Keʼxyaabʼa chiru 30 kutan. Joʼkan naq laj Eleazar, ralal laj Aaron, kikanaak choʼq aj tij saʼ xyanqebʼ laj Israel.Números 20:1-13, 22-29; Deuteronomio 29:5. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA TZʼAQAL kʼantiʼ wank chiru li cheʼ? Inkʼaʼ, li kʼantiʼ aʼin re chʼiichʼ. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises naq tixkʼe li kʼantiʼ chiru cheʼ re naq ebʼ li qas qiitzʼin teʼril ut inkʼaʼ teʼkamq. Abʼan, ebʼ li kʼantiʼ li wankebʼ chiru chʼochʼ yoʼyookebʼ. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut naq ebʼ li kʼantiʼ aʼin keʼtiwok ut keʼkʼehok yajel?

Xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼxweechʼi li Yos ut keʼxweechʼi laj Moises. Keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xooʼaawisi Egipto. Tookamq saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ aʼin? Maakʼaʼ qatzakahemq chi moko wank ta qahaʼ. Ut inkʼaʼ chik naqaj xwabʼal li mana›.

Li mana chaabʼil tzakahemq. Rikʼin li mana li Jehobʼa kixkʼutbʼesi chiru li xtenamit jun chik li sachbʼachʼoolej. Joʼkan ajwiʼ naq kixkʼehebʼ xhaʼ. Abʼan ebʼ laj Israel moko keʼroxloqʼi ta li kixkʼe li Jehobʼa rehebʼ. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixtaqla ebʼ li kʼantiʼ aʼin, re naq teʼtiweʼq ut teʼkamq.

Tojaʼ naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼxye re laj Moises: ‹Xoomaakobʼk chiru li Jehobʼa ut chaawu. Tijon chiqix re naq li Jehobʼa trisihebʼ li kʼantiʼ saʼ qayanq›. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kitijok chirixebʼ. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises naq tixyiibʼ jun li kʼantiʼ re chʼiichʼ ut tixkʼe chiru cheʼ. Re naq li teʼtiweʼq teʼril li kʼantiʼ chiru li cheʼ ut teʼkʼiraaq. Laj Moises kixbʼaanu li kixye li Yos, joʼkan naq li keʼtiweʼk, keʼkʼiraak.

Kʼaru naqatzol chirix aʼin? Naqatzol naq chiqajunilo tiwbʼilo ajwiʼ joʼebʼ laj Israel. Xbʼaan naq laj Adan ut li xʼEva keʼxtzʼeqtaana li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq nokoocheekobʼk, nokooyajerk ut nokookamk. Abʼan li Jehobʼa naraj naq twanq qayuʼam chi junelik.

Li Jehobʼa kixtaqla li Ralal saʼ Ruuchichʼochʼ. Naabʼalebʼ inkʼaʼ keʼwulak chiru xkʼanjel li Jesus, joʼkan naq keʼxye naq maaʼus xnaʼlebʼ ut keʼxkʼe chiru cheʼ. Abʼan li Jehobʼa kixtaqla li Jesus re qakolbʼal. Wi tqabʼaanu li naxye qe li Jesus naru twanq qayuʼam chi junelik. Toj tqatzol chik xkomon li naʼlebʼ aʼin.Números 21:4-9; Juan 3:14, 15. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA AAWABʼIHOM chi aatinak jun li bʼuur? Inkʼaʼ, peʼyaal? Xbʼaan naq ebʼ li xul inkʼaʼ nekeʼaatinak. Abʼan, li Santil Hu naxye naq jun li bʼuur kiʼaatinak. Qilaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.

Yook chi wulak xqʼehil naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼoq saʼ li tenamit Canaan. Abʼan laj Balac, li awabʼej re Moab, naxuwahebʼ laj Israel. Joʼkan naq, kixtaqla xsikʼbʼal laj Balaam re naq tixmaajewa ebʼ laj Israel. Laj Balaam xko rilbʼal laj Balac xbʼaan naq kiyeechiʼiik naabʼal li tumin re.

Li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ naraj naq laj Balaam tixmaajewa li xtenamit. Joʼkan naq kixtaqla jun li anjel re naq tixram xbʼe laj Balaam. Laj Balaam inkʼaʼ kiril li anjel, abʼan li bʼuur kiril li anjel aʼin. Li bʼuur kiraj xjalbʼal xbʼe ut inkʼaʼ kiru, joʼkan naq kixbʼuchubʼ ribʼ chiru chʼochʼ. Naq li bʼuur kixbʼaanu aʼin, kʼajoʼ naq kichalk xjosqʼil laj Balaam joʼkan naq kiʼok xsakʼbʼal.

Li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq laj Balaam trabʼi naq li xbʼuur kixye re: ‹Kʼaʼut naq yookat insakʼbʼal?›

Laj Balaam kichaqʼok: ‹Xaabʼaanu naq tinkanaaq saʼ xutaan, wi wank raj junaq inchʼiichʼ tatinkamsi raj!›

Tojaʼ naq kixye li bʼuur: ‹Ma ak xinbʼaanu junsutaq aawe aʼin?›

‹Inkʼaʼ!› Chan laj Balaam.

Chirix chik aʼan li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq laj Balaam tril naq wank li anjel chiru. Li anjel kixye re laj Balaam: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xaasakʼ laabʼuur? Xinchalk xrambʼal laabʼe re naq inkʼaʼ taamaajewa li tenamit Israel. Wi laabʼuur inkʼaʼ raj xbʼuchubʼ ribʼ; xatinkamsi raj. Abʼan, inkʼaʼ raj xinchʼeʼ laabʼuur!›

Laj Balaam kixye re li anjel: ‹Xinmaakobʼk, inkʼaʼ ninnaw naq wankat arin!› Li anjel kixkanabʼ chi xik laj Balaam. Chirix chik aʼan, laj Balaam xko rikʼin laj Balac. Laj Balaam kixyal xmaajewankil li tenamit Israel, abʼan li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq laj Balaam trosobʼtesi oxibʼ sut li xtenamit.Números 21:21-35; 22:1-40; 23:1-30; 24:1-25. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Moises kiraj ok saʼ li tenamit Canaan rochbʼeenebʼ laj Israel. Joʼkan naq kixye re li Jehobʼa: ‹Kanabʼin chi numeʼk saʼ junpaakʼal li nimaʼ Jordan re naq twil li chaabʼil chʼochʼ›. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises: ‹Kanabʼ xyeebʼal aʼan!› Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut kixye aʼin li Jehobʼa?

Xbʼaan naq laj Moises ut laj Aaron inkʼaʼ keʼxkʼe xloqʼal li Jehobʼa naq kiʼelk chaq li haʼ saʼ li pek. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye naq inkʼaʼ teʼoq saʼ li tenamit Canaan.

Wuqubʼ po xkamik laj Aaron naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises: ‹Kʼam laj Josue ut kʼe chiru laj Eleazar, laj tij, ut chiru li tenamit. Chiru li tenamit taaye naq laj Josue tjolominq rehebʼ›. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq laj Moises yook xbʼaanunkil joʼ kiyeheʼk re xbʼaan li Jehobʼa.

Tojaʼ naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Josue: ‹Kawaq aachʼool ut matxuwak. Laaʼat tatkʼamoq rehebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Canaan li xinyeechiʼi rehebʼ. Laaʼin wanqin aawikʼin!›

Chirix chik aʼan, li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises naq taaxik saʼ li tzuul Nebo re li naʼajej Moab. Saʼ li tzuul aʼin, laj Moises kiril chixjunil rusilal li tenamit Canaan. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises: ‹Aʼin li chʼochʼ xinyeechiʼi rehebʼ li ralal xkʼajol laj Abrahan, laj Isaac ut laj Jacob. Xatinkanabʼ chi rilbʼal, abʼan inkʼaʼ tat-oq aran›.

Laj Moises kikamk saʼ li tzuul Nebo naq wank 120 chihabʼ re. Toj kaw ribʼ ut saqenk naʼilok. Naq kikamk laj Moises kʼajoʼ naq keʼrahoʼk saʼ xchʼool ebʼ laj Israel ut keʼyaabʼak chirix! Anaqwan laj Josue tjolominq rehebʼ, joʼkan naq sahebʼ wiʼ chik saʼ xchʼool.Números 27:12-23; Deuteronomio 3:23-29; 31:1-8, 14-23; 32:45-52; 34:1-12. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

EBʼ LI winq aʼin wankebʼ saʼ chʼaʼajkilal, tento naq teʼeleliq re naq inkʼaʼ teʼkamsiiq. Ebʼ li winq aʼin, ebʼ aj Israel. Li ixq li yook chi tenqʼank rehebʼ aʼan li xRahab. Li rochoch li xRahab wank chire xnubʼaal li tenamit Jerico. Qilaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.

Akʼ okebʼ re laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Canaan naq laj Josue kixtaqla wiibʼ li winq ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Cheeril chaq li chʼochʼ ut li tenamit Jerico›. Naq ebʼ li wiibʼ aj Israel keʼwulak saʼ li tenamit Jerico, keʼok saʼ rochoch li xRahab. Jun rehebʼ li poyanam kixye re li awabʼej re Jerico: ‹Chi qʼeq keʼok chaq wiibʼ laj Israel chi rilbʼal li tenamit›. Joʼkan naq li awabʼej kixtaqlahebʼ winq saʼ rochoch li xRahab. Ut keʼxye re li xRahab: ‹Isihebʼ chaq laj Israel saʼ laawochoch!› Li xRahab kixmuqebʼ li wiibʼ aj Israel saʼ xbʼeen li rochoch ut kixye: ‹Yal naq keʼkʼulunk wiibʼ chi winq saʼ wochoch, abʼan inkʼaʼ ninnaw aj bʼarebʼ. Xkohebʼ naq ak okebʼ re xtzʼapbʼal li rokebʼaal li tenamit. Wi texxik saʼ junpaat chirixebʼ, teetawebʼ chaq!› Joʼkan naq ebʼ li winq kohebʼ saʼ aanil.

Naq xkohebʼ li winq, li xRahab kixye rehebʼ laj Israel: ‹Laaʼin ninnaw naq li Jehobʼa tixkʼe eere li tenamit aʼin. Xqabʼi resil naq li Jehobʼa kixchaqihobʼresi li Kaqi Palaw naq kexʼelk chaq Egipto. Ut naq xeekamsi ebʼ li awabʼej re Sehon ut Og›. Li xRahab kixye ajwiʼ: ‹Laaʼin xexintenqʼa. Joʼkan naq cheebʼaanu usilal, cheekolaq linnaʼ linyuwaʼ, ebʼ li was ut ebʼ li wiitzʼin!›

Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxkʼulubʼa li kixye li xRahab, abʼan kiyeheʼk re: ‹Taabʼakʼ jun li kaqi kʼaam chiru laabʼentaan ut taachʼutubʼ laajunkabʼal saʼ laawochoch. Naq toochalq xsachbʼal li tenamit Jerico ut tqil li kʼaam aʼin, maaʼani tixkamsi laajunkabʼal›. Naq ebʼ li wiibʼ chi winq keʼwulak rikʼin laj Josue keʼxye re chixjunil li keʼxkʼul chaq saʼ li tenamit Jerico.Josué 2:1-24; Hebreos 11:31. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

KʼARU yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil ebʼ laj Israel? Yookebʼ chi numeʼk saʼ xyi li nimaʼ Jordan. Abʼan bʼar xko li haʼ? Saʼebʼ li kutan aʼan, naxkʼe naabʼal li habʼ ut saʼ junpaat nabʼutʼunk li nimaʼ. Abʼan, anaqwan maakʼaʼ chik li haʼ! Ebʼ laj Israel yookebʼ chi numeʼk saʼ xyi, joʼ keʼxbʼaanu chaq saʼ li Kaqi Palaw. Qilaq bʼar xko chixjunil li haʼ.

Naq xwulak xkutankil naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼnumeʼq saʼ li nimaʼ, li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Josue naq tixye rehebʼ laj Israel: ‹Ebʼ laj tij teʼkʼamoq re xkaaxil li sumwank ut teʼkʼamoq bʼe chiqu. Ut naq teʼxkʼe li roq saʼ li nimaʼ li haʼ tchaqiq›.

Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj tij keʼxkʼam xkaaxil li sumwank ut keʼkʼamok bʼe chiruhebʼ laj Israel. Li nimaʼ kaw roq ut cham xsaʼ. Naq ebʼ laj tij keʼwulak saʼ li nimaʼ inkʼaʼ keʼxuwak naq keʼxchʼik ribʼ saʼ haʼ. Ut naq keʼxkʼe li roq saʼ li haʼ, kiʼok chi chaqik li nimaʼ! Li Jehobʼa kixtzʼap xbʼe li haʼ, aʼan jun chik li sachbʼachʼoolej. Ebʼ laj tij keʼxkʼam xkaaxil li sumwank ut keʼkanaak saʼ xyi li nimaʼ. Chirix chik aʼan, keʼok chi numeʼk ebʼ laj Israel joʼ nakʼutunk saʼ li eetalil. Naq keʼnumeʼk chixjunilebʼ laj Israel, li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Josue naq tixsikʼ 12 chi winq kawebʼ ribʼ ut tixye rehebʼ: ‹Ayuqex saʼ li nimaʼ bʼarwiʼ wankebʼ laj tij rikʼin xkaaxil li sumwank. Aran teerisi 12 chi pek ut teekʼe bʼarwiʼ teenumsi li qʼoqyink. Wi wulaj kabʼej leeralal leekʼajol teʼxpatzʼ eere, kʼaru xyaalal ebʼ li 12 chi pek aʼin? Teeye rehebʼ naq li nimaʼ Jordan kichaqik naq keʼxnumsi xkaaxil li sumwank saʼ xyi li nimaʼ. Ebʼ li pek tixjultika eere li sachbʼachʼoolej aʼin›. Laj Josue kixkʼe ajwiʼ 12 chi pek bʼarwiʼ keʼxaqli laj tij saʼ li nimaʼ.

Chirix chik aʼan laj Josue kixye rehebʼ laj tij: ‹Elenqex saʼ li nimaʼ Jordan!› Naq ebʼ laj tij keʼelk chisaʼ, li nimaʼ kiʼok wiʼ chik chi bʼutʼunk.Josué 3:1-17; 4:1-18. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LI XNUBʼAAL li tenamit Jerico yook chi tʼaneʼk. Chanchan hiik yook chi bʼaanunk re! Aʼin jun chik li sachbʼachʼoolej kixbʼaanu li Jehobʼa. Qilaq chanru kixbʼaanu.

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Josue: ‹Laaʼat ut ebʼ laj puubʼ li wankebʼ aawikʼin teesuti chixjunil li tenamit. Jun sut ajwiʼ chiru li kutan teesuti li tenamit Jerico ut teebʼaanu chiru waqibʼ kutan. Teekʼam xkaaxil li sumwank ut wuqubʼ aj tij teʼxik chiru li kaax aʼin ut yooqebʼ xyaabʼasinkil ebʼ li pur›.

Kixye ajwiʼ: ‹Saʼ xwuq li kutan, wuqubʼ sut teesuti li tenamit. Moko teekanabʼ ta xyaabʼasinkil li pur ut teejap eere chi kaw. Tojaʼ naq xnubʼaal li tenamit ttʼaneʼq!›



Laj Josue ut ebʼ laj Israel keʼxbʼaanu li kixye li Jehobʼa. Naq yookebʼ xsutinkil li tenamit maaʼani kiʼeekʼank. Kaʼajwiʼ xyaabʼ li pur ut roqebʼ naʼeekʼank. Ebʼ laj Jerico yookebʼ tana xiw. Ma nakaawil jun li kaqi kʼaam saʼ li bʼentaan? Aʼan xbʼentaan li rochoch li xRahab. Li xRahab kixbʼaanu li keʼxye li wiibʼ aj Israel. Li xRahab ut li junkabʼal wankebʼ saʼ li ochoch ut yookebʼ rilbʼal li yook chi kʼulmank.

Saʼ xwuq li kutan, naq keʼraqeʼk xsutinkil wuqubʼ sut li tenamit keʼxchʼeʼ li pur, keʼxjap rehebʼ laj puubʼ. Tojaʼ naq li xnubʼaal li tenamit Jerico kitʼaneʼk. Chirix chik aʼan laj Josue kixye: ‹Kamsimaq ebʼ laj Jerico ut teekʼat chixjunil li wank saʼ li tenamit. Abʼan inkʼaʼ teekʼat li plaat, li oor, li kaqi chʼiichʼ ut chixjunil li chʼiichʼ li teetaw. Aʼin tkʼanjelaq saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa›.

Laj Josue kixye rehebʼ li wiibʼ aj Israel li keʼwulak chi rilbʼal li tenamit Jerico: ‹Isimaq chaq li xRahab ut li xjunkabʼal›. Joʼkan naq li xRahab ut li xjunkabʼal keʼkoleʼk.Josué 6:1-25. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Wank Jun aj Elqʼ saʼ Israel
data.contenido:
MA NAKAANAW kʼaru yook xmuqbʼal li winq aʼin saʼ li rochoch? Yook xkʼeebʼal rubʼel chʼochʼ jun li chaabʼil tʼikr, li oor ut li plaat. Li winq aʼin kirisi chaq li kʼaʼaq re ru saʼ li tenamit Jerico. Ma jultik aawe kʼaru kixye laj Josue naq teʼxbʼaanu rikʼin chixjunil aʼin?

Laj Josue kixye naq teʼxkʼat chixjunil, abʼan li oor ut li plaat teʼxkʼam saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Ebʼ li poyanam aʼin keʼxqʼet Raatin li Yos, xbʼaan naq keʼelqʼak. Li winq aʼin, aʼan laj Acan ut wank rochbʼeen li xjunkabʼal. Qilaq kʼaru chik kikʼulmank.

Ak kiʼelqʼak chaq laj Acan naq laj Josue kixtaqla jun chʼuut aj Israel chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Hai. Abʼan ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ keʼelk chiʼus, naabʼalebʼ keʼkamk ut wankebʼ keʼelelik. Kʼajoʼ naq kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool laj Josue joʼkan naq kixhupubʼ ribʼ ut kixye re li Jehobʼa: ‹Kʼaʼut xaakanabʼ naq tqakʼul li rahilal aʼin!›

Tojaʼ naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Josue: ‹Waklin! Ebʼ laj Israel xeʼmaakobʼk chiwu. Keʼyeheʼk re naq teʼxkʼat malaj teʼxkʼam saʼ li wochoch li kʼaʼaq re ru. Keʼrelqʼa jun chaabʼil tʼikr ut inkʼaʼ keʼxye. Inkʼaʼ texwosobʼtesi, wi inkʼaʼ teekʼat li tʼikr ut teekamsi laj elqʼ›. Li Jehobʼa kixye naq tixkʼut chiru laj Josue ani kiʼelqʼak.

Naq laj Josue kixchʼutubʼebʼ laj Israel, li Jehobʼa kixkʼut chiruhebʼ naq laj elqʼ aʼan laj Acan. Tojaʼ naq laj Acan kixye: ‹Xinmaakobʼk. Xwil naq chʼinaʼus li tʼikr, wank li oor ut li plaat. Kʼajoʼ naq xwulak chiwu joʼkan xinkʼam! Chixjunil aʼin taataw saʼ xyi li wochoch aran xinmuq›.

Naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼxkʼam chaq re laj Josue li kʼaʼaq re ru aʼin, laj Josue kixye re laj Acan: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xooʼaakʼe saʼ rahilal? Anaqwan taatoj saʼ ruqʼ li Jehobʼa!› Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼxkʼe chi pek laj Acan ut li xjunkabʼal toj reetal naq keʼkamsiik. Aʼin naxkʼut chiqu naq moko us ta xchapbʼal li maawaʼ qe.

Chirix chik aʼan, ebʼ laj Israel kohebʼ wiʼ chik chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Hai. Anaqwan keʼelk chiʼus xbʼaan naq li Jehobʼa kitenqʼank rehebʼ.Josué 7:1-26; 8:1-29. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

NAABʼALEBʼ li tenamit re Canaan yookebʼ xkawresinkil ribʼ re xqʼaxbʼal ruhebʼ laj Israel saʼ li yalok. Abʼan ebʼ laj Gabaon keʼxkʼoxla naq li Yos wank rikʼinebʼ laj Israel. Joʼkan naq inkʼaʼ keʼraj yalok rikʼinebʼ. Xbʼaan naq keʼxkʼoxla naq wi teʼxbʼaanu, teʼyaloq rikʼin li Yos. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru keʼxbʼaanu laj Gabaon?

Ebʼ laj Gabaon keʼxyoobʼ naq najt keʼchalk chaq. Joʼkan naq, keʼxkʼe chirixebʼ pejel tʼikr ut pejel xaabʼ. Keʼxkʼe qʼeel iiq saʼ xbʼeenebʼ li xbʼuur ut kawil kaxlan wa keʼxkʼam chirixebʼ. Naq keʼwulak rikʼin laj Josue keʼxye re: ‹Najt nokoochalk chaq. Wanko arin, xbʼaan naq xqabʼi resil naq nim xwankil leeYos, Jehobʼa. Xqabʼi li kixbʼaanu cheerix naq kexʼelk chaq Egipto. Joʼkan naq ebʼ li nekeʼjolomink saʼ li qatenamit, keʼxye qe naq tqakʼam chaq qawa ut toochalq xyeebʼal eere: Naqaj wank choʼq eemoos ut mexyalok qikʼin. Kʼeemaq reetal naq najt nokoochalk xbʼaan naq pejel chik li qatʼikr ut qaxaabʼ ut moko us ta chik li qawa!›

Laj Josue ut ebʼ laj jolominel keʼxpaabʼ rehebʼ laj Gabaon. Joʼkan naq keʼxye rehebʼ naq inkʼaʼ teʼyaloq rikʼinebʼ. Abʼan, naq kinumeʼk oxibʼ kutan ebʼ laj Israel keʼxnaw naq moko najt ta li xtenamitebʼ laj Gabaon.

Tojaʼ naq laj Josue kixye rehebʼ: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xeeye qe naq najt nekexchalk?›

Ebʼ laj Gabaon keʼxye: ‹Xqabʼi resil naq leeYos, Jehobʼa, kixyeechiʼi xkʼeebʼal eere li tenamit Canaan. Joʼkan naq xooxuwak ut xqakʼoxla naq naru tooʼeekamsi›. Ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ keʼxkamsi ebʼ laj Gabaon, abʼan keʼxkanabʼ choʼq xmoosebʼ.

Li awabʼej re Jerusalen kichalk xjosqʼil xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj Gabaon keʼxkʼe ribʼ saʼ aatin rikʼinebʼ laj Israel. Joʼkan naq li awabʼej aʼin, kixye rehebʼ kaahibʼ chik chi awabʼej: ‹Chineetenqʼa chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Gabaon›. Joʼkan naq ebʼ li oobʼ chi awabʼej keʼyalok rikʼinebʼ laj Gabaon. Ma us naq ebʼ laj Gabaon keʼxkʼe ribʼ saʼ aatin rikʼinebʼ laj Israel?Josué 9:1-27; 10:1-5. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

KʼARU yook xbʼaanunkil laj Josue? Laj Josue yook xyeebʼal: ‹Saqʼe, kanaqat aran!› Joʼkan naq li Saqʼe kikanaak saʼ xyi li choxa chiru jun kutan. Li Jehobʼa kibʼaanunk re aʼin. Qilaq kʼaʼut naq laj Josue kiraj naq li Saqʼe inkʼaʼ t-oq.

Naq ebʼ li oobʼ chi awabʼej re Canaan keʼok chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laj Gabaon, ebʼ laj Gabaon keʼxtaqla jun li winq chi xsikʼbʼal laj Josue re naq teʼtenqʼaaq. Li winq kixye re laj Josue: ‹Chalqat saʼ junpaat ut chooʼaakol! Chixjunilebʼ li awabʼej li wankebʼ saʼ li qasutam keʼchalk chi yalok rikʼinebʼ laamoos›.

Laj Josue ut ebʼ laj puubʼ kohebʼ saʼ junpaat chi xkolbʼalebʼ laj Gabaon ut keʼbʼeek chiru jun qʼoqyink. Naq keʼwulak rikʼinebʼ laj Gabaon, ebʼ laj puubʼ re li oobʼ chi awabʼej kʼajoʼ naq keʼxuwak ut keʼelelik. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixkut saʼ xbʼeenebʼ li nimla saqbʼach ut naabʼalebʼ laj puubʼ re Canaan keʼkamk. Joʼkan naq moko kʼihebʼ ta chik keʼxkamsi ebʼ laj puubʼ li keʼchalk chirix laj Josue.

Naq laj Josue kiril naq li Saqʼe yook chi ok, kiʼok xkʼaʼuxl xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj puubʼ re Canaan teʼeleliq naq tqʼoqyinoʼq. Joʼkan naq laj Josue kitijok chiru li Jehobʼa ut kixye: ‹Saqʼe kanaqat aran!› Naq li Saqʼe kikanaak saʼ xnaʼaj ebʼ laj Israel keʼelk chi ubʼej saʼ li yalok.

Abʼan toj naabʼalebʼ li awabʼej re Canaan xikʼ nekeʼril xtenamit li Yos. Chiru waqibʼ chihabʼ kiru laj Josue ut ebʼ laj puubʼ xsachbʼalebʼ li 31 chi awabʼej. Chirix chik aʼan, laj Josue kixjekʼi li tenamit Canaan saʼ xyanqebʼ li xteep laj Israel li maakʼaʼebʼ xnaʼaj.

Laj Josue kikamk naq wank 110 chihabʼ re. Naq toj yoʼyo laj Josue ut ebʼ li ramiiw, li tenamit kiʼabʼink chiru li Jehobʼa. Abʼan, naq laj Josue ut ebʼ li ramiiw keʼkamk, ebʼ laj Israel keʼok xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal ut keʼxkʼe ribʼ saʼ chʼaʼajkilal. Anaqwan aajel ru naq li Yos ttenqʼanq rehebʼ.Josué 10:6-15; 12:7-24; 14:1-5; Jueces 2:8-13. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

EBʼ LAJ Israel keʼtijok chiru li Jehobʼa naq keʼxchʼik ribʼ saʼ chʼaʼajkilal. Joʼkan naq li Yos kixtaqlahebʼ laj kʼamol bʼe re naq teʼtenqʼaaq. Li Santil Hu naxye naq ebʼ laj kʼamol bʼe wankebʼ choʼq aj raqol aatin. Laj Josue kiwank choʼq aj kʼamol bʼe ut choʼq aj raqol aatin. Naq laj Josue kikamk, li Jehobʼa kixkʼe laj Otniel, laj Ehud ut laj Samgar choʼq ebʼ aj raqol aatin. Joʼkan ajwiʼ, wiibʼ li ixq keʼtenqʼank rehebʼ laj Israel. Aʼan xDebora ut li xJael. Li xDebora naxnaw kʼaru tkʼulmanq saʼ li kutan chaalel. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye re li xDebora naq tixnumsi li esil chiru li tenamit. Li xDebora aj raqol aatin ajwiʼ. Naq li xDebora wank rubʼel jun li cheʼ, ebʼ laj Israel nekeʼwulak rikʼin re naq teʼtenqʼaaq chi xtuqubʼankil ruhebʼ li xchʼaʼajkilal.

Saʼebʼ li kutan aʼin laj Jabin wank choʼq awabʼej re Canaan ut wank 900 xbʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ. Chixjunilebʼ laj puubʼ li nekeʼkʼanjelak rikʼin laj Jabin kawebʼ ribʼ, joʼkan naq naabʼalebʼ laj Israel keʼkanaak choʼq xmoos. Laj Jabin kixkʼe laj Sisara chi jolomink saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj puubʼ.

Saʼ jun kutan li xDebora kixbʼoq laj Barac, laj raqol aatin, ut kixye re: ‹Li Jehobʼa kixye: Kʼamebʼ saʼ li tzuul Tabor 10.000 chi winq ut aran tinqʼaxtesi aawe laj Sisara ut ebʼ laj puubʼ re naq taaqʼaxebʼ ru›.

Tojaʼ naq laj Barac kixye re li xDebora: ‹Laaʼin tinxik wi tatxik chiwix›. Li xDebora kixsume xik chirix laj Barac. Abʼan li xDebora kixye re laj Barac: ‹Moko laaʼat ta tkʼeheʼq aaloqʼal, xbʼaan naq li Jehobʼa tixqʼaxtesi laj Sisara saʼ ruqʼ jun li ixq›. Qilaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.

Laj Barac kikubʼeek chaq saʼ li tzuul Tabor chi xtawbʼal laj Sisara ut ebʼ laj puubʼ. Li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq tbʼutʼunq li naʼaj ut naabʼalebʼ laj puubʼ keʼkamk. Joʼkan naq laj Sisara kiʼelk saʼ li xbʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ ut kiʼelelik.

Chirix chik aʼan laj Sisara kiwulak saʼ rochoch li xJael. Li ixq kiroksi laj Sisara ut kixkʼe leech chi rukʼ. Naq laj Sisara kirukʼ li leech kikubʼeek xwara. Tojaʼ naq li xJael kixchap jun li cheʼ ut kixchʼik saʼ xjolom laj Sisara. Naq laj Barac kiwulak rikʼin li xJael, li xJael kixkʼut chiru naq kamenaq chik laj Sisara. Chi joʼkan kitzʼaqlok ru li kixye xDebora.

Chirix chik aʼan keʼxkamsi laj Jabin ut sa chik keʼwank ebʼ laj Israel.Jueces 2:14-22; 4:1-24; 5:1-31. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

SAʼ LI Santil Hu wank jun li tasal hu, Rut xkʼabʼaʼ. Chisaʼ wank resil jun li junkabʼal. Li junkabʼal aʼin, keʼwank naq ebʼ laj raqol aatin yookebʼ chi jolomink saʼ li tenamit Israel. Li xRut aʼan jun li ixqaʼal kichalk saʼ li tenamit Moab. Li xRut kixra li Jehobʼa xbʼaan naq kixtzol naq aʼan li tzʼaqal Yos. Li xNoemi aʼan jun li cheekel ixq li kitenqʼank re li xRut chi xnawbʼal ru li Jehobʼa.

Li xNoemi kiyoʼlaak saʼ li tenamit Israel. Naq kiʼok chi raqeʼk li tzakahemq saʼ li tenamit Israel, li xNoemi ut li xbʼeelom kohebʼ saʼ li tenamit Moab ut keʼxkʼam chirixebʼ li wiibʼ xkokʼal. Chirix chik aʼan, kikamk li xbʼeelom li xNoemi ut ebʼ li xyum keʼsumlaak rikʼin wiibʼ li ixqaʼal aj Moab. Lajeebʼ chihabʼ tana xsumlajikebʼ xyum li xNoemi rikʼin xRut ut xʼOrpa naq keʼkamk. Ra saʼ xchʼool xNoemi! Kʼaru tixbʼaanu anaqwan?

Saʼ jun kutan li xNoemi kisutqʼiik saʼ li xtenamit. Li xRut ut xʼOrpa keʼraj wank rikʼin li xNoemi, joʼkan naq xkohebʼ chirix. Ak naabʼal kutan xikikebʼ naq li xNoemi kixye rehebʼ li ixqaʼal: ‹Sutqʼinqex saʼ leetenamit ut ayuqex rikʼin leenaʼ›.

Li xNoemi kixchaqʼrabʼihebʼ ut kixtzʼubʼebʼ ru. Ebʼ li ixqaʼal keʼok chi yaabʼak xbʼaan naq nekeʼxra li xNoemi. Joʼkan naq keʼxye: ‹Laaʼo tooxik chaawix saʼ laatenamit›. Li xNoemi kixye rehebʼ: ‹Tento naq texsutqʼiiq rikʼin leekomon, us wanqex aran›. Joʼkan naq li xʼOrpa kisutqʼiik saʼ li xtenamit. Abʼan li xRut kikanaak rikʼin li xNoemi.

Tojaʼ naq li xNoemi kixye re li xRut: ‹Kʼe reetal li xʼOrpa kisutqʼiik, ayu ajwiʼ laaʼat chirix›. Li xRut kixye: ‹Maaye chik we naq tatinkanabʼ! Kanabʼin chi xik chaawix, bʼaanu usilal! Bʼar tatxik aran tinxik; bʼar wanqat aran wanqin. Laatenamit aʼanaq ajwiʼ lintenamit; laaYos aʼanaq ajwiʼ linYos. Bʼar tatkamq aran ajwiʼ tinkamq›. Naq li xRut kixye chixjunil aʼin, li xNoemi kixkanabʼ xyeebʼal re xRut naq tsutqʼiiq.

Joʼkan naq li xRut ut li xNoemi keʼwulak Israel ut aran keʼkanaak. Li xRut kiʼok chi kʼanjelak saʼ junpaat xbʼaan naq ak xqʼehil xsikʼbʼal li sebʼaad. Jun li winq aj Boaz xkʼabʼaʼ kixkanabʼ naq li xRut tsikʼoq sebʼaad saʼ li xchʼochʼ. Ma nakaanaw ani xkʼabʼaʼ xnaʼ laj Boaz? Aʼan li xRahab li kiwank chaq saʼ li tenamit Jerico.

Saʼ jun kutan laj Boaz kixye re li xRut: ‹Ninnaw naq chaabʼilat rikʼin li xNoemi. Ninnaw ajwiʼ naq xaakanabʼ laanaʼ laayuwaʼ ut laatenamit. Xatchalk saʼ li tenamit aʼin li maajunwa aanawom ru. Li Jehobʼa t-osobʼtesinq aawe!›

Li xRut kixye re laj Boaz: ‹Kʼajoʼ aachaabʼilal wikʼin. Rikʼin laawaatin xaakʼojobʼ linchʼool!› Laj Boaz kiril naq li xRut chʼinaʼus ut kisumlaak rikʼin. Kʼajoʼ kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool li xNoemi naq keʼsumlaak! Abʼan kinumtaak xsahil xchʼool li xNoemi naq kiyoʼlaak laj Obed, li ralal laj Boaz rikʼin xRut. Li xyuwaʼchin laj David aʼan laj Obed. Moqon chik tqatzol ani laj David.Li tasal hu Rut 1-4. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Laj Gedeon ut Ebʼ li 300 chi Winq
data.contenido:
ANIHEBʼ li winq wankebʼ saʼ li eetalil? Aʼanebʼ laj puubʼ re Israel. Ut li winq li yook rilbʼal chanru nekeʼukʼak ebʼ laj Israel, aʼan laj Gedeon. Laj Gedeon aj raqol aatin re Israel.

Ma nakaakʼe reetal naq jalan jalanq nekeʼukʼak ebʼ laj Israel? Wankebʼ nekeʼxkubʼsi ribʼ saʼ haʼ. Abʼan, ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut naq jun rehebʼ li winq inkʼaʼ naxkubʼsi xjolom naq yook chi ukʼak? Xbʼaan naq chi joʼkan tixkʼe reetal kʼaru yook chi kʼulmank saʼ li xsutam. Li xnaʼlebʼ li winq aʼin us, xbʼaan naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Gedeon naq tixsikʼebʼ ru kaʼajwiʼ li inkʼaʼ nekeʼxkubʼsi xjolom naq nekeʼukʼak. Ut li nekeʼxkubʼsi xjolom teʼsutqʼiiq saʼebʼ li rochoch. Qilaq kʼaʼut naq li Yos kixye aʼin.

Ebʼ laj Israel wankebʼ wiʼ chik saʼ chʼaʼajkilal, xbʼaan naq inkʼaʼ keʼabʼink chiru li Jehobʼa. Ebʼ laj Madian kawebʼ ribʼ ut nekeʼxrahobʼtesi laj Israel. Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼtijok chiru li Jehobʼa re naq tixtenqʼahebʼ. Li Jehobʼa kirabʼi li keʼxtzʼaama chiru.

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Gedeon naq tixsikʼ jun chʼuut chi winq. Joʼkan naq laj Gedeon kixchʼutubʼ 32.000 ebʼ laj puubʼ. Abʼan 135.000 teʼyaloq saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Israel. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Gedeon: ‹Naabʼalebʼ laj puubʼ xaachʼutubʼ›. Kʼaʼut naq li Jehobʼa kixye aʼin?

Li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ kiraj naq teʼxkʼoxla naq moko aajel ta naq aʼan ttenqʼank rehebʼ naq teʼyaloq saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Madian. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Gedeon: ‹Ye rehebʼ li yookebʼ xxiw naq teʼsutqʼiiq saʼebʼ li rochoch›. Joʼkan naq 22.000 keʼsutqʼiik. Kaʼaj chik 10.000 ebʼ aj Israel keʼkanaak rikʼin laj Gedeon. Abʼan 135.000 xkʼihalebʼ laj Madian li teʼyaloq saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Israel!

Li Jehobʼa kixye wiʼ chik re laj Gedeon: ‹Toj naabʼal laj puubʼ chaawu!› Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Gedeon naq tixkʼehebʼ chi ukʼak ebʼ laj Israel chire li haʼ. Chixjunilebʼ li teʼxkubʼsi ribʼ chi ukʼak, teʼsutqʼiiq saʼebʼ li rochoch. Chirix chik aʼan li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Gedeon: ‹Tinqʼaxtesihebʼ laj Madian saʼ laawuqʼ ut saʼ ruqʼebʼ li 300 chi winq li inkʼaʼ keʼxkubʼsi xjolom naq keʼukʼak›. Naq xwulak xkutankil li yalok, laj Gedeon kixjekʼihebʼ li 300 chi winq saʼ oxibʼ chʼuut. Kixkʼe rehebʼ li junjunq xxukubʼ ut xkukebʼ rikʼin xaml. Ak wulak re xtuqtuukil li qʼoqyink naq laj Gedeon ut ebʼ li 300 chi winq keʼxsut chixjunil xnaʼajebʼ laj Madian. Keʼxyaabʼasi li xxukubʼ ut keʼxjor li xkukebʼ. Tojaʼ naq keʼxye: ‹Xoochalk saʼ xkʼabʼaʼ li Jehobʼa ut laj Gedeon!› Naq keʼajk ru ebʼ laj Madian keʼsach xnaʼlebʼ, keʼxuwak ut keʼelelik. Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼelk chiʼus saʼ li yalok.Jueces 6–8. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MAARE xaayeechiʼi xbʼaanunkil junaq li naʼlebʼ malaj kʼanjel. Ut naq kiwulak xkutankil xkʼeebʼal li xaayeechiʼi xchʼaʼajkoʼk tana chaawu xbʼaanunkil. Aʼan kixkʼul laj Jefte, li winq li wank saʼ li eetalil, joʼkan naq ra saʼ xchʼool. Laj Jefte kaw chaq ribʼ chi yalok ut kiwank choʼq aj raqol aatin.

Laj Jefte kiwank saʼ xkutankil naq ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ chik nekeʼxloqʼoni li Jehobʼa ut yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixkanabʼ naq teʼrahobʼtesiiq xbʼaanebʼ laj Amon. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxye re li Jehobʼa: ‹Xoomaakobʼk chaawu. Chooʼaakol, bʼaanu usilal!›

Ebʼ laj Israel inkʼaʼ sa nekeʼreekʼa ribʼ, xbʼaan naq yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal. Joʼkan naq keʼok wiʼ chik xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixtenqʼahebʼ.

Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxsikʼ laj Jefte re naq tjolominq saʼ xyanqebʼ saʼ li yalok. Ebʼ laj Israel teʼyaloq rikʼinebʼ laj Amon. Laj Jefte kiraj naq li Jehobʼa ttenqʼank re. Joʼkan naq kixye re li Jehobʼa: ‹Wi taakʼe saʼ wuqʼ ebʼ laj Amon, tinqʼaxtesi aawe li t-elk chaq xbʼeenwa chinkʼulbʼal naq tinsutqʼiiq saʼ wochoch›. Li Jehobʼa kirabʼi li kixye laj Jefte ut kixtenqʼa. Naq laj Jefte kiwulak saʼ rochoch, ma nakaanaw ani kiʼelk chi xkʼulbʼal? Li xrabʼin kiʼelk chaq chi xkʼulbʼal. Jun ajwiʼ xrabʼin laj Jefte. Joʼkan naq kiʼok chi yaabʼak ut kixye: ‹At inrabʼin, kʼajoʼ narahoʼk inchʼool aabʼaan! Xinkʼe li waatin re li Jehobʼa, joʼkan naq tento tinkʼe li xinyeechiʼi re›.

Naq li xrabʼin laj Jefte kixnaaw li xyeechihom li xyuwaʼ, kirahoʼk ajwiʼ saʼ xchʼool. Xbʼaan naq tixkanabʼ li xyuwaʼ ut ebʼ li ramiiw. Ut tkanaaq chi junajwa saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Chirix chik aʼan kixye re li xyuwaʼ: ‹Wi xaakʼe laawaatin re li Jehobʼa tento naq taabʼaanu li xaayeechiʼi re›.

Joʼkan naq li xrabʼin laj Jefte xko Silo ut kiʼok chi kʼanjelak saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Rajlal chihabʼ ebʼ li ixqaʼal re Israel nekeʼkanaak kaahibʼ kutan rikʼin xrabʼin laj Jefte saʼ Rochoch li Yos. Ebʼ laj Israel, kʼajoʼ naq nekeʼxra li xrabʼin laj Jefte xbʼaan naq yook chi kʼanjelak chi anchal xchʼool chiru Jehobʼa.Jueces 10:6-18; 11:1-40. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Sanson jwal kaw xmetzʼew chiru yalaq ani ut kiwank choʼq aj raqol aatin. Ma nakaanaw ani kikʼehok re xmetzʼew? Aʼan li Jehobʼa. Maajiʼ ajwiʼ nayoʼlaak laj Sanson naq li Jehobʼa kixye re li xnaʼ: ‹Chi seebʼ twanq jun aakʼuulaʼal. Aʼan tkʼamoq bʼe ut tixkolebʼ laj Israel saʼ ruqʼebʼ laj Filisteo›.

Ebʼ laj Filisteo maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ ut nekeʼxrahobʼtesi ebʼ laj Israel. Saʼ jun kutan naq laj Sanson yook chi xik Canaan bʼarwiʼ wankebʼ chaq laj Filisteo kixtaw jun nimla kaqkoj. Laj Sanson kixkamsi li kaqkoj rikʼin ruqʼ ut kixkamsi naabʼalebʼ aj Filisteo.

Chirix chik aʼan laj Sanson xko xchʼool chirix jun li ixq, xDalila xkʼabʼaʼ. Ebʼ li keʼjolomink rehebʼ laj Filisteo keʼraj xnawbʼal bʼar nachalk xmetzʼew laj Sanson. Joʼkan naq keʼxye re xDalila naq teʼxkʼe re 1.100 ru li plaat chixjunqalebʼ wiʼ tixye rehebʼ kʼaʼut naq wank xmetzʼew laj Sanson. Li xDalila kisahoʼk xchʼool naq kirabʼi xkʼihal li tumin. Joʼkan naq moko kixkanabʼ ta xpatzʼbʼal re laj Sanson bʼar nachalk xmetzʼew. Li xDalila moko tzʼaqal ramiiw ta laj Sanson, chi moko wank ta choʼq ramiiw li xtenamit li Yos.



Li xDalila kixnaw bʼar nachalk xmetzʼew laj Sanson xbʼaan naq laj Sanson kixye re: ‹Maajunwa keʼxbʼes li wismal. Naq xinyoʼlaak li Yos kixsikʼ wu re naq tinkʼanjelaq chiru choʼq aj Nazareo. Joʼkan naq wi teʼxbʼes li wismal tsachq linmetzʼew›.

Naq xDalila kirabʼi aʼin, kixwartesi laj Sanson chiru li raʼ ut kiroksi jun li winq saʼ rochoch re naq tixbʼes li rismal. Naq kiʼajk ru laj Sanson maakʼaʼ chik xmetzʼew. Tojaʼ naq ebʼ laj Filisteo keʼxchap laj Sanson, keʼrisi saʼ li ru ut keʼxkʼe choʼq xmoosebʼ.



Ebʼ laj Filisteo keʼxbʼaanu jun li ninqʼe re xloqʼoninkil li xyosebʼ Dagon. Tojaʼ naq keʼrisi chaq laj Sanson saʼ tzʼalam ut keʼok xseʼenkil. Abʼan laj Sanson ak xchamoʼk wiʼ chik li rismal. Laj Sanson kixye re li chʼinaʼal li yook chi kʼamok re: ‹Kʼehin chi xchʼeebʼal roqechal li ochoch›. Chirix chik aʼan laj Sanson kixpatzʼ xmetzʼew re li Jehobʼa. Tojaʼ naq kixchap roqechal li ochoch. Kixjap re ut kixye: ‹Kanabʼin chi kamk rikʼinebʼ laj Filisteo!› Saʼ li ninqʼe wankebʼ 3.000 aj Filisteo. Naq laj Sanson kixkʼe xmetzʼew, kitʼaneʼk li ochoch ut chixjunilebʼ keʼkamk.Jueces 13–16. data.titulo: Li Chʼinaʼal saʼ Rochoch li Yos
data.contenido:
KʼAJOʼ xchʼinaʼusal li chʼinaʼal li wank saʼ li eetalil. Aj Samuel xkʼabʼaʼ. Li winq li yook xchʼeebʼal xjolom laj Samuel aʼan laj Eli, aj tij re Israel. Ut li keʼkʼamok re laj Samuel rikʼin laj Eli, aʼanebʼ li xnaʼ xyuwaʼ, xʼAna ut laj Elqana.

Laj Samuel wank kaahibʼ malaj oobʼ chihabʼ re, naq kikanaak saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa rikʼin laj Eli ut ebʼ laj tij. Abʼan, kʼaʼut naq li xʼAna ut laj Elqana keʼchalk xkanabʼankil laj Samuel re naq tkʼanjelaq saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa?

Naq toj maajiʼ nayoʼlaak laj Samuel li xʼAna ra saʼ xchʼool, xbʼaan naq moko naru ta nawank xkʼuulaʼal. Saʼ jun kutan kiwulak saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa chi tijok ut kixye: ‹At Jehobʼa, minsachk saʼ aachʼool! Wi taakʼe junaq inkʼuulaʼal tinqʼaxtesi aawe re naq tkʼanjelaq chaawu chi junelik›.

Li Jehobʼa kixsume li xtij li xʼAna, joʼkan naq kiyoʼlaak laj Samuel. Li xʼAna naxra li xchʼina yum ut toj kachʼin naq kixkʼut chiru chirix li Jehobʼa. Li xʼAna kixye re li xbʼeelom: ‹Naq wanq kaahibʼ malaj oobʼ chihabʼ re laj Samuel tinqʼaxtesi chaq re li Jehobʼa re naq tkʼanjelaq chiru›.

Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq li xʼAna ut laj Elqana keʼxkanabʼ laj Samuel saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Laj Samuel sa xchʼool xbʼaan naq tkʼanjelaq saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Naq toj kachʼin laj Samuel li xnaʼ xyuwaʼ keʼxkʼut chiru chirix li Jehobʼa. Li xʼAna ut laj Elqana rajlal chihabʼ nekeʼwulak saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa chi loqʼonink ut nekeʼril chaq laj Samuel. Joʼkan ajwiʼ li xʼAna rajlal chihabʼ naxkʼam re laj Samuel jun li akʼil aqʼ.

Ak naabʼal chihabʼ xnumeʼk ut laj Samuel toj yook chi kʼanjelak saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Laj Samuel naxsahobʼresi xchʼool li Jehobʼa ut li tenamit. Ebʼ li ralal laj Eli aʼanebʼ laj Hofni ut laj Finehas. Maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ ut keʼxbʼaanu ajwiʼ naq jalanebʼ chik teʼxqʼet Raatin li Yos. Joʼkan naq tento raj naq laj Eli trisihebʼ li ralal choʼq aj tij, abʼan inkʼaʼ kixbʼaanu.

Laj Samuel inkʼaʼ kixkanabʼ kʼanjelak chiru li Yos usta yookebʼ xbʼaanunkil li maaʼusilal saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa. Ut chiru naabʼal chihabʼ li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ chik kiʼaatinak rikʼin junaq winq. Xbʼaan naq moko naabʼalebʼ ta nekeʼxra li Yos. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixkʼul laj Samuel naq kinimank?

Laj Samuel yook chi wark saʼ Rochoch li Jehobʼa naq kirabʼi naq yook chi bʼoqeʼk. Joʼkan naq laj Samuel kiwakli ut kixye chaq re laj Eli: ‹Arin wankin! Xbʼaan naq xinaabʼoq›.

Laj Eli kixye re: ‹Laaʼin inkʼaʼ xatinbʼoq, ayu warin chaq›. Joʼkan naq laj Samuel kisutqʼi chi wark.

Laj Samuel kirabʼi saʼ xkabʼ sut naq kiyeheʼk re: ‹Samuel!› Laj Samuel xko wiʼ chik rikʼin laj Eli ut kixye re: ‹Arin wankin! Xwabʼi naq xinaabʼoq›. Tojaʼ naq laj Eli kixye wiʼ chik re: ‹At walal! Inkʼaʼ xatinbʼoq, warin chaq›. Ut laj Samuel kisutqʼi saʼ xwaribʼ.

Laj Samuel kirabʼi naq kiyeheʼk re saʼ rox sut: ‹Samuel!› Kiwakli ut kixye re laj Eli: ‹Arin wankin! Anaqwan xwabʼi naq xinaabʼoq›. Tojaʼ naq laj Eli kixkʼe reetal naq li Jehobʼa yook chaq xbʼoqbʼal laj Samuel. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Samuel: ‹Yoklan chaq ut naq tatxbʼoq wiʼ chik taaye: Aatinan at Jehobʼa! Laj kʼanjel chaawu yook chaawabʼinkil›.

Joʼkan kixbʼaanu laj Samuel naq kibʼoqeʼk wiʼ chik. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Samuel naq traqoq aatin saʼ xbʼeen laj Eli ut ebʼ li ralal. Chirix chik aʼan, laj Hofni ut laj Finehas keʼkamk naq keʼyalok rikʼinebʼ laj Filisteo. Naq laj Eli kirabʼi li keʼxkʼul ebʼ li ralal kitʼaneʼk, kixtoq li xkux ut kikamk. Chi joʼkan kitzʼaqlok ru li kixye li Jehobʼa.

Naq kiwinqiloʼk laj Samuel kaʼaj chik aʼan kiwank choʼq aj raqol aatin saʼ li tenamit Israel. Ut naq laj Samuel kicheekobʼk ebʼ laj Israel keʼxye re: ‹Sikʼ junaq winq re naq t-aawabʼejinq saʼ qabʼeen›. Laj Samuel inkʼaʼ kiwulak chiru aʼin, xbʼaan naq li Jehobʼa aʼan li awabʼej saʼ xbʼeenebʼ. Abʼan, li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Samuel naq trabʼi li tenamit.1 Samuel 1:1-28; 2:11-36; 3:1-18; 4:16-18; 8:4-9. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru
